stem: What is the difference in the way China is described in the two selections?

options.label: A
options.text: In “American Apple” products are plentiful, while in the excerpt from Bend, Not Break: A Life in Two Worlds wealth is scarce.

options.label: B
options.text: In “American Apple” people rely on economic exchanges, while in the excerpt from Bend, Not Break: A Life in Two Worlds people are more self-sufficient.

options.label: C
options.text: In “American Apple” people are suspicious of their government, while in the excerpt from Bend, Not Break: A Life in Two Worlds the government is obeyed without concern.

options.label: D
options.text: In “American Apple” corruption is more prevalent in business, while in the excerpt from Bend, Not Break: A Life in Two Worlds commerce is centered on fairness.
